python3 << 'PYEOF'
import re

with open('Makefile', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Find the conflict block and extract stage 2 (the main branch version)
# The conflict is: <<<<<<< HEAD ... ======= ... >>>>>>> 
# HEAD = stage 2 (upstream/main), >>>>>>> = stage 3 (feature)
conflict_pattern = re.compile(r'<<<<<<< HEAD\n(.*?)\n=======\n(.*?)\n>>>>>>> [^\n]+\n', re.DOTALL)

match = conflict_pattern.search(content)
if match:
    upstream_version = match.group(1)  # stage 2 (main)
    feature_version = match.group(2)   # stage 3 (feature branch)
    
    # The upstream version from HEAD is the main branch version 
    # We need to add test-token-cost and test-render-cost-line to main's version
    # Insert them after "test-render-run-summary"
    resolved = upstream_version.replace(
        'test-render-run-summary test-fix-issue-write-final-report',
        'test-render-run-summary test-token-cost test-render-cost-line test-fix-issue-write-final-report'
    )
    
    resolved_content = content[:match.start()] + resolved + '\n' + content[match.end():]
    
    with open('Makefile', 'w') as f:
        f.write(resolved_content)
    
    print("Conflict resolved successfully")
    print(f"upstream had: {len(upstream_version)} chars")
    print(f"feature had: {len(feature_version)} chars")
    print(f"resolved has: {len(resolved)} chars")
else:

PYEOF
